sections.heading: 模式产地、分布与经济重要性
sections.heading_en: Type locality, distribution and economic importance
sections.heading_es: Localidad tipo, distribución e importancia económica

paragraphs.text: 根据 Ranjith 与 Kalleshwaraswamy（2021）研究，胖身土白蚁（Odontotermes obesus，Rambur 1842）的模式产地为印度孟买，在南印度安得拉邦、卡纳塔克邦、喀拉拉邦、泰米尔纳德邦四邦均有分布记录。
paragraphs.text_en: According to Ranjith and Kalleshwaraswamy (2021), the type locality of Odontotermes obesus (Rambur, 1842) is Mumbai, India, and the species has been recorded from four states of southern India: Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
paragraphs.text_es: Según Ranjith y Kalleshwaraswamy (2021), la localidad tipo de Odontotermes obesus (Rambur, 1842) es Bombay (India), y la especie está registrada en cuatro estados del sur de la India: Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala y Tamil Nadu.

paragraphs.text: 据摘要，根据 Becker（1962）研究，对户外用材而言，异白蚁属（Heterotermes）与乳白蚁属（Coptotermes）的重要性相对较低，而小白蚁属（Microtermes）、胖身土白蚁（Odontotermes obesus）与锯白蚁属（Microcerotermes）更值得注意；截至 1962 年，已知能取食活立木的种包括胖身土白蚁。
paragraphs.text_en: According to the abstract, Becker (1962) found that, for timber used out of doors, Heterotermes and Coptotermes were of comparatively low importance, whereas Microtermes, Odontotermes obesus and Microcerotermes were more noteworthy; as of 1962, the species known to feed on living trees included Odontotermes obesus.
paragraphs.text_es: Según el resumen, Becker (1962) encontró que, para la madera empleada a la intemperie, Heterotermes y Coptotermes tenían una importancia relativamente baja, mientras que Microtermes, Odontotermes obesus y Microcerotermes merecían mayor atención; hasta 1962, entre las especies conocidas por alimentarse de árboles vivos figuraba Odontotermes obesus.

references.citation: Ranjith, M.; Kalleshwaraswamy, C. M. 2021. Termites (Blattodea: Isoptera) of southern India: current knowledge on distribution and systematic checklist. Wildlife Information Liaison Development Society.
Günther Becker. 1962. Beiträge zur Kenntnis der geographischen Verbreitung und wirtschaftlichen Bedeutung von Termiten in Indien1. Zeitschrift für Angewandte Entomologie.
